item_name: Rothco Heavyweight EDC / CCW Leather Gun Belt
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Heavyweight EDC/CCW Leather Gun Belt is made of thick heavy-duty full grain leather and stainless steel hardware that has been designed to support the weight of your firearm, which makes it ideal for concealed carry or everyday carry equipment.
description: Rothco’s Heavyweight EDC/CCW Leather Gun Belt is made of thick heavy-duty full grain leather and stainless steel hardware that has been designed to support the weight of your firearm, which makes it ideal for concealed carry or everyday carry equipment. The concealed carry leather belt is 1.5” wide and can fit 5/8” belt loops. This EDC belt features a 3.45 MM prong and 5 holes at the end of the belt each spaced 1” apart.
